description: Pairs you with a Motion browser tab. The user has an eight-character code on screen, under the Connect MCP button — something like K7M4-P2Q9. Call this once at the start. It returns a session token; pass that token to every other tool. The code itself stops working the moment it is used, so keep the token, not the code.

code.description: The eight-character pairing code shown on the Motion page.

name: connect
